title.rendered: New High School and Transformations Building Tours – Summer 2021

content.rendered:
Last fall marked the completion of construction on our new Sherwood High School, as well as on our three Transformations schools (the new Sherwood Middle School, Hawks View Elementary, and Ridges Elementary). While the start of the 2020-21 school year had always been intended as the “grand opening” of these bond projects, the pandemic and the resulting school closures prevented our district from opening these buildings to families and the community the way we had spent so long planning for. 

We know that over the course of the last year, families and community members have remained interested in seeing the results of the bond work first-hand — and now, with the 2020-21 school year behind us, we are excited to announce that our district will be hosting tour opportunities at these locations this summer!  Starting next week, we will be offering building tours each Thursday afternoon on the following dates:

  • July 1 – Sherwood High School
  • July 8 – Sherwood Middle School
  • July 15 – Ridges Elementary
  • July 22 – Sherwood High School
  • July 29 – Sherwood Middle School
  • August 5 – Hawks View Elementary

Each date will provide two tour opportunities, with 20 spots available at each time (on a first come, first served basis), and sign-up is required in advance for tour participation. Please note that additional dates/times may be added later in the summer, based on interest and staff availability. Non-vaccinated participants are asked to please adhere to current face covering guidance at the time of their tour. 

To sign up, please visit the links below:
